internal_note: Point-only batch by explicit user direction; routes are intentionally empty for now. The downloaded abshr-khlwgn.gpx is for the already catalogued Kolougan waterfall, not Gol-Akhur. Piran's Wikiloc GPS waypoint elevation (about 733 m) differs from GLO-90 DEM by over 100 m; use the DEM value for the forecast point and retain the discrepancy in this note. Aghuyeh's other Wikiloc page contains coordinates inconsistent with the named village and downloaded track; the latter's endpoint is used, with source conflict documented. Shah Kuh South Khorasan is excluded until summit identity/height/coordinate are reconciled: available mapping and hiking reports disagree materially.
